visualCharacteristics: Customer testimonial slider with thumbnail, name, clamped description and Read More control; heading and View All Reviews button sit above.
contentPattern: Section heading and "View All Reviews" link (<em> = outline button) as default content before the block. One row per testimonial: thumbnail image | name heading + description paragraph | "Read More" paragraph.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any quote/review slider with image, name and text.
